IT Systems & Support Technician (Industrial Automation)

About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you. Accompanying your application, we would prefer to see a cover letter detailing your specific software and hardware troubleshooting experience

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Our client, Kaza Group, is a Melbourne-based integrated property, hospitality, and facility management business. The business delivers structured, end-to-end service solutions across managed portfolios, combining disciplined operational execution, measurable service standards, and a long-term focus on asset protection. Their services span property and facility management, hospitality service delivery, cleaning and presentation standards, and day-to-day operational support for the properties and clients under management.

This is a full-time role with an annual salary of $80,000 to $81,000 plus superannuation.

Reporting to senior management, the Service Manager is responsible for organising and controlling the cleaning services operations delivered across Kaza Group's managed portfolio of properties, ensuring consistent cleaning and presentation standards, effective staffing, regulatory compliance, and sound financial management across the cleaning service function, alongside oversight of related facility and hospitality service support.

Responsibilities include:

•	Organising and controlling the day-to-day cleaning services operations across Kaza Group's managed portfolio, coordinating cleaning teams and presentation standards across all managed properties and client sites.

•	Promoting and selling Kaza Group's cleaning and presentation service packages to property Owners and clients, and identifying opportunities to expand the range of cleaning services provided across the portfolio.

•	Controlling the selection, training, rostering, and supervision of cleaning services staff, ensuring consistent, high-quality cleaning and presentation standards are maintained across all managed sites.

•	Planning and organising the mix and level of cleaning services provided, staff resourcing and rostering, and consumables/equipment levels required to maintain agreed cleaning standards across the portfolio.

•	Observing and ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, chemical handling and other regulations applicable to the cleaning services and properties managed.

•	Developing, implementing and reviewing policies, programs and procedures concerning cleaning service standards, quality control and the range of cleaning services provided to clients and property Owners.

•	Maintaining financial records relevant to the cleaning services function, preparing and managing budgets, and monitoring costs against agreed service levels.

•	Overseeing operational standards across the managed portfolio, including security, presentation and housekeeping standards, and coordinating scheduled and reactive cleaning and maintenance works.

•	Liaising with property owners, clients, and contractors to ensure cleaning service delivery meets agreed expectations, and preparing regular reporting on cleaning service performance across the portfolio.

•	Managing the day-to-day administration of the cleaning services function, including rostering, incident reporting, quality audits, and staff performance management.

Qualifications:

•	Must possess a qualification comparable to an AQF Diploma or higher, ideally in a field such as business management, retail management, or hospitality management.

•	Relevant prior experience in a service, facility, property or hospitality management role, with particular attention to detail.
•	Should have at least one to two (1-2) years of experience in a similar setting.

•	Strong staff management and supervisory skills, including the ability to select, train, and manage a diverse service delivery team.

•	Excellent written and oral communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with property Owners, clients, contractors, and staff at all levels.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to assess service issues and develop practical, effective solutions.

•	Sound financial management skills, including budgeting and cost control experience.

•	Detail-oriented, with the ability to multitask, work independently and prioritise competing operational demands across a portfolio of sites.

## Sales and Marketing Manager
## Position Overview
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Sales and Marketing Manager to lead and execute strategic commercial initiatives across our organisation. This role is central to driving revenue growth, brand positioning, and market expansion through the effective management of both sales operations and marketing programmes. The ideal candidate is a confident leader with a proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. You will bring a strategic mindset, strong analytical capability, and the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams.
## Key Responsibilities
- Formulate, implement, and continuously refine integrated sales and marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and growth targets
- Develop and oversee advertising, public relations, and promotional campaigns, working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external agencies to maximise brand impact
- Establish and manage sales territories, customer service standards, and product mix to optimise market coverage and revenue performance
- Direct and coordinate the activities of sales personnel, agents, and distributors to ensure consistent execution of sales methods and commercial objectives
- Set pricing structures, credit arrangements, and discount frameworks in line with market conditions and company profitability targets
- Oversee merchandising methods and distribution policy, ensuring product availability and visibility across all relevant channels
- Monitor and analyse market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to inform strategic decision-making and identify new business opportunities
- Develop and manage the sales and marketing budget, tracking expenditure and return on investment to ensure efficient allocation of resources
- Lead the generation and nurturing of leads across digital and traditional channels, converting pipeline opportunities into long-term client relationships
- Produce regular performance reports and present findings to senior leadership, providing data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and industry stakeholders to support retention and business development
- Recruit, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and professional growth
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline
- Minimum of 5 years' experience in a sales and/or marketing management role, with demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding commercial targets
- Strong understanding of both B2B and B2C sales environments, including pipeline management and customer lifecycle strategies
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, content, and traditional media
- Proficiency in CRM platforms and marketing automation tools, with the ability to leverage data for strategic insight
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present to senior stakeholders and external partners
- Demonstrated leadership capability, with experience managing, coaching, and developing sales and marketing teams
- High level of commercial acumen and a customer-centric approach to business development
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within deadlines
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualification such as a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent
- Professional accreditation with the Australian Marketing Institute (AMI) or a recognised industry body
- Experience working within a specific industry relevant to our business, such as retail, technology, professional services, or FMCG
- Familiarity with SEO, SEM, and performance marketing strategies, as well as experience managing digital advertising budgets
- Exposure to international or cross-regional markets, including an understanding of export or distribution networks
- Experience with sales enablement tools, marketing analytics platforms, or enterprise-level CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values innovation, initiative, and professional development
- Access ongoing learning and career progression opportunities, including support for further study, industry certifications, and leadership programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available, supporting a healthy work-life balance
- Benefit from a competitive remuneration package, including performance-based incentives that reward your contribution to the business
- Join a team culture built on trust, inclusivity, and shared purpose, where your ideas are heard and your impact is recognised
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
